mapper.select: SELECT ORDER_ID, USER_ID, ORDER_CODE, ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT, SUBTOTAL, SHIPPING_FEE, DISCOUNT, TOTAL, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode}
SELECT ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT ORDER_ITEM_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_OPTION_ID, PRODUCT_SNAPSHOT, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, LINE_TOTAL FROM ORDER_ITEMS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY ORDER_ITEM_ID ASC
SELECT ORDER_ID, USER_ID, ORDER_CODE, ADDRESS_SNAPSHOT, SUBTOTAL, SHIPPING_FEE, DISCOUNT, TOTAL, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM ORDERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ORDER_CODE = #{orderCode}

SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_CODE, O.STATUS, O.TOTAL, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEMS WHERE ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID) AS ITEM_COUNT, (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(PRODUCT_SNAPSHOT, '$.productName')) FROM ORDER_ITEMS WHERE ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID ORDER BY ORDER_ITEM_ID LIMIT 1) AS FIRST_PRODUCT_NAME, (SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(PRODUCT_SNAPSHOT, '$.coverImageUrl')) FROM ORDER_ITEMS WHERE ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID ORDER BY ORDER_ITEM_ID LIMIT 1) AS FIRST_COVER_IMAGE, O.CREATED_AT FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
